requirement_vague: Verify user deletion fails when user has articles (FK constraint, no cascade delete)
requirement_precise: Create user1 (username: 'orphanauthor1', email: 'orphanauthor1@test.com', password: 'pass123'). User1 creates article with title 'Orphan Article Test'. GET /api/articles and verify article exists with author username 'orphanauthor1'. DELETE /api/users/orphanauthor1@test.com. Verify response is 500 (FK constraint error). GET /api/articles again and verify article still exists. This tests that articles block user deletion (no CASCADE DELETE configured).

implementation.location: DELETE /api/users/{email} in delete_user_by_email; Article.author_id foreign key in Article model; GET /api/articles in list_articles

implementation.reasoning: The Article model stores a foreign key to User without any cascade delete configuration, so deleting a user with existing articles is blocked by the database constraint. The delete_user_by_email route catches the resulting failure and returns HTTP 500, and since the transaction is rolled back, the article remains available through GET /api/articles with its author's username preserved.
